name: Abhishek Saikia
bio_short: I write about technology, system internals and design, and the ideas shaping how we live. I also build things — tools, experiments, and the occasional essay that won't let me sleep.
bio_long: I'm Abhishek Saikia, a programmer and thinker based in India. I think carefully about technology, language, and how people make sense of the world.
My writing tends to sit at the intersection of culture and craft — how ideas travel, how tools shape thought, and how to do good work with limited time and attention.
I write here irregularly but with intention.
If something I've written resonated with you, I'd genuinely love to hear about it.
